QuestInfo.name: Start
QuestInfo.0: The jewel in the Knight of Light's shield can restore your brother to life. For your father's sake, and your own, you must become the Knight of Light and awaken that shield.
QuestInfo.1: It takes years of training to become the Knight of Light. Take the #bBeginner Warrior's Sword#k out of the weapon box and get your daily practice in.
QuestInfo.2: Keep up with your training, and your brother may yet return to life.
